entryLinks.name: Assault Squad with Gas Granade Launchers

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This unit can reroll any test once a round. you cannot reroll a test that was already rerolled using this rule.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This unit can auto-success one ranged damage test per every attack targeted at this unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If you fail to deal any damage to the target during shooting, roll additional d10 (the suppresion test), if you manage to get result +6, target unit looses its ability to shoot this round.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When performing a Shooting Test, this unit may reroll the result once.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When this unit deals at least one damage to an opponent's unit with a ranged attack, the target gains a Suffering Modifier. This unit cannot gain Suffering Modifier because of an opponent's attack with this Special Rule.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This weapon gains +3 Lethality if the target is closer to the shooter than 6 inches. The distance is measured from any model having a weapon with Flamethrower rule.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: this unit cannot be a target of charge, this unit cannot charge, this unit cannot melee, this unit gains Mobile modifier if it did not shoot in the previous round (and loses the Mobile modifier when shoots), this unit cannot be designated as target by ranged attack if the attacker’s weapon does not have the Armor Piercing Special Rule.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If you deal any damage to the target during shooting, this target gains Shaken modifier for the next round.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This weapon is able to deal damage to units with Vehicle and Super-Heavy rules.
